description: For total computable injections \(f,g:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N\), the specified maps \(h,k\) are total computable numerical inverses. For every label type \(L\) and arbitrary maps \(\ell_X,\ell_Y:\mathbb N\to L\) satisfying \(\ell_X(x)=\ell_Y(f(x))\) and \(\ell_Y(y)=\ell_X(g(y))\), the same \(h\) satisfies \(\ell_X(x)=\ell_Y(h(x))\) for every \(x\). Neither labels nor their equality need be computable or numerically encodable.
